text: The safety instrumented system (SIS) shall be designed per IEC 61511 with SIL verification, including burner management (NFPA 85) and HRSG protection functions (ER-12.03). The SIS shall be physically and logically separate from the DCS: own logic solver, own I/O, own networks, own power supply, own engineering station, own sensors and final elements for each safety instrumented function.
